title: Fix My Profile page and header avatar to bind name/email/photoURL from Firestore users/{uid}

requirements.text: Update the existing My Profile page to display profile photo, full name, and email address strictly from the Firestore document at `users/{uid}` (fields: `photoURL`, `name`, `email`) and not from Firebase Auth user fields.

quotes:
Fix ONLY the existing "My Profile" page and header avatar.

TASK:
Bind data correctly from Firestore.

SOURCE OF TRUTH:
Firestore document: users/{uid}

FIELDS TO READ:
- name
- email
- photoURL

RULES:
- Do NOT read data from Firebase Auth

acceptanceCriteria: On the My Profile page, the profile photo source is bound to `users/{uid}.photoURL` and the full name text is bound to `users/{uid}.name`.
On the My Profile page, the email address text is bound to `users/{uid}.email`.
The My Profile page does not use any Firebase Auth fields (e.g., auth user email/photo/displayName) for display values; displayed values come from Firestore profile data.
If Firestore `users/{uid}` exists, its `name/email/photoURL` values are shown on the My Profile page.

requirements.text: On the My Profile page avatar, implement a deterministic fallback: if `users/{uid}.photoURL` is missing/empty, do not attempt to load an image and instead show initials derived from `users/{uid}.name`.

quotes:
My Profile page:
- Profile photo must load from users/{uid}.photoURL
- Full Name text must show users/{uid}.name
- Email Address text must show users/{uid}.email
- If photoURL is empty, show initials from name

acceptanceCriteria: When `photoURL` is an empty string or undefined, the My Profile avatar renders initials (derived from the Firestore `name`) rather than a broken/empty image.
When `photoURL` is a non-empty string, the My Profile avatar renders the image from Firestore.

requirements.text: Update the existing header (top-right avatar) to use Firestore `users/{uid}.photoURL` for the avatar image and fall back to initials derived from Firestore `users/{uid}.name` when `photoURL` is missing/empty; do not use Firebase Auth for any displayed profile fields.

quotes:
Header (top right avatar):
- Use users/{uid}.photoURL
- Fallback to initials from name

RULES:
- Do NOT read data from Firebase Auth

acceptanceCriteria: Header avatar image source is `users/{uid}.photoURL` (from Firestore profile data).
If `photoURL` is empty/missing, the header avatar shows initials derived from Firestore `name` and does not attempt to load an empty image URL.
No header avatar display values (image/name/initials) are derived from Firebase Auth fields.

requirements.text: Ensure the data used by the My Profile page and header avatar is fetched from Firestore `users/{uid}` as the single source of truth (reading only `name`, `email`, `photoURL` for binding) and that the UI updates to show Firestore data whenever it exists.

quotes:
SOURCE OF TRUTH:
Firestore document: users/{uid}

FIELDS TO READ:
- name
- email
- photoURL

If Firestore data exists, it must display. Nothing else.

acceptanceCriteria: With an existing Firestore doc `users/{uid}`, both My Profile and the header avatar display the Firestore `name/email/photoURL` values.
No routes/navigation, roles/approval logic, or UI layout/design are changed as part of this fix.

constraints: SINGLE TASK ONLY: change only data fetching/binding for the existing My Profile page and the header (top-right avatar).
Do not modify: Signup page, Login page, Admin dashboard, User list, routes or navigation, or overall UI layout/design.
Do not read profile display data (name/email/photoURL) from Firebase Auth; Firestore `users/{uid}` is the source of truth.
Do not change roles, approval logic, or rebuild unrelated functionality.
nonGoals: Adding new UI components or redesigning the My Profile page or header.
Changing authentication flows, signup/login behavior, route guards, routing table, or navigation.
Changing Firestore schema, security rules, or any admin/user approval logic.
